_description: Owner-verified PL_breakdown / CSM_waterfall cells. Values the owner has hand-fixed or explicitly confirmed-as-correct. The anomaly triage (scripts/triage_anomaly_candidates.py) suppresses these so the LLM-skeptic never re-flags them as EXTRACTION_ERROR. Match key = (master, company, item) with whitespace-insensitive item compare; `value` is the confirmed live value — suppression only applies while the master still matches it within tolerance, so a later drift re-surfaces. Add a cell here whenever the owner confirms a statistically-odd-but-correct value. | 2026-08-20: IFRS17_BS 법정준비금(항목5~8) legit-zero 도 같은 레지스트리로 면제한다 — 회사가 기적립액 전액을 환입예정으로 상계해 잔액이 정말 0인 케이스. R-RSV-6(ZERO_AFTER_NONZERO)가 이 셀들을 재플래그하지 않게 한다.
